2. **Rating: 5.0**
   - Title: The best of the five new pairs of shoes I had ...
   - Text: The best of the five new pairs of shoes I had to buy because of a problem with the nail on a big toe. The toe area is soft and roomy. It's padding is only second to good running shoes.

3. **Rating: 5.0**
   - Title: No more feet issues
   - Text: They are the best shoe ever; I have plantar fasciitis (or did have) and since wearing these I can walk my 3-4 miles a day with NO pain. Have tried taping, cheap splints, physical therapy but nothing helped until I found these shoes.
   Nothing like Mephisto and I bought another pair so I can have them when the other wears out.
   I cannot say enough great things about this shoe. If you want comfort and durability then this shoe is for you.
